Cabinet & Pouring

Stage definitions

Exact slices of the parent sequence.

Canonical instructions, handedness, action width, horizon, and success conditions are drawn from the current task registry and success-contract documentation.

#Stage / environmentHandActionMax stepsSuccess summary
01Open cabinetCabinetPourDoorOpen-v1Left29600Open the cabinet door to at least 80° and hold for five control steps.
02Place bottleCabinetPourBottlePickPlace-v1Right29900Remove the bottle, place it upright inside the target region, release it, and hold stable for five steps.
03Remove capCabinetPourCapRemovePlace-v1Right291400Rotate the cap by at least 180°, detach it, and place it flat and released on the table.
04Pour contentsCabinetPourPour-v1Right29700Place at least 12 of 16 particles in the bowl, spill at most two, and hold for ten steps.
